title: ISO 27001 Audit Intern
description:
**Internship Duration:** 6 Months (Onsite)

**Location:** Onsite

**Function:** Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) / Assurance / Audit

**Reports to:** Audit Manager / Lead Auditor / GRC Program Lead

**Role Summary :**

As a **GRC Audit Intern**, you will support audit teams in planning, evidence collection, testing, and reporting for management system and assurance engagements, including **ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS), ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS), ISO/IEC 27701 (PIMS), SOC 2**, and compliance assessments aligned to **HIPAA, GDPR, and India’s DPDP Act**. This is a hands\-on, onsite internship designed to build practical skills in audit execution, controls testing, and compliance documentation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Support \& Execution**

* Assist auditors during **onsite** audits: meeting notes, evidence walkthroughs, and coordination with client stakeholders.
* Support **audit planning** activities: scope understanding, sampling lists, and evidence requests.
* Perform **controls testing support** under supervision (design/implementation checks) for security, privacy, and AI governance controls.

**Evidence Collection \& Documentation**

* Collect and organize evidence (policies, SOPs, logs, tickets, screenshots, configurations, training records).
* Maintain evidence trackers and ensure proper naming, versioning, and traceability.
* Help map evidence to standard/framework requirements (clauses, controls, Trust Services Criteria, regulatory requirements).

**Gap Assessment \& Reporting**

* Support identification of gaps, observations, OFIs, and nonconformities with clear references.
* Draft sections of audit deliverables: checklists, working papers, meeting minutes, and summary notes.
* Assist with corrective action follow\-ups: tracking CAPA status and closure evidence.

**Tools \& Coordination**

* Update audit trackers, risk registers, SoA/controls mapping sheets, and project documentation repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams for scheduling, logistics, and documentation completeness.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow internal information security policies at all times.

**Standards / Framework Exposure (During Internship)**

You may work across one or more of the following (based on project allocation):

* **ISO/IEC 27001:2022** – Information Security Management Systems
* **ISO/IEC 42001:2023** – AI Management Systems (AIMS)
* **ISO/IEC 27701:2019** – Privacy Information Management Systems (PIMS)
* **SOC 2** – Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, Privacy)
* **HIPAA** – Security/Privacy Rule alignment (as applicable)
* **GDPR** – Privacy compliance assessment support
* **DPDP Act (India)** – Data protection compliance support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in **Information Security, Computer Science, IT, Risk/Compliance, Cybersecurity, Law/Policy (tech)** or related fields.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity audit concepts and frameworks.

**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**

* Familiarity with any of: ISO 27001 controls, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DPDP, risk assessment, privacy principles.
* Interest in AI governance/AI risk and model lifecycle basics (helpful for ISO 42001 projects).

**Internship Outcomes / Learning**

* Understanding how certification/assurance audits are conducted and how evidence is evaluated.
* Improved professional writing: working papers, checklists, summaries, and CAPA tracking.
* Exposure to multi\-framework compliance expectations across security, privacy, and AI governance.

**Professional Expectations**

* Maintain strict confidentiality and follow security policies.
* Be punctual and dependable for onsite schedules and client meetings.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
* Conduct yourself professionally with clients and internal teams.

**Potential Full\-Time Conversion (Post Internship):**

Subject to **Performance**, selected interns may be considered for **Conversion to a Full\-time Position** at the end of the 6\-month internship.

Job Types: Fresher, Internship

We are looking for ambitious, career\-driven professionals to join our distribution network as a Provisional Distribution Manager (PDM).

This role offers a structured Fast\-Track Career Progression Path. Candidates will initially join the organization as a Financial Advisor for a 6\-month provisional period. Upon meeting the minimal business targets and successfully fulfilling the activity criteria during this period, you will be officially confirmed and promoted to the role of Distribution Manager, taking charge of your own team and distribution channel.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Provisional Phase (Months 1–6\):** Actively operate as a Financial Advisor to gain hands\-on experience in market development, customer acquisition, and financial planning.
* **Target Achievement:** Meet the minimal sales milestones and performance metrics defined for the 6\-month provisional window to secure your management transition.
* **Client Advisory:** Analyze customer needs, provide tailored life insurance solutions from PNB MetLife’s product portfolio, and maintain long\-term client relationships.
* **Agency Building Preparation:** Learn the core competencies of recruitment, training, and team leadership required to manage your future team of advisors effectively.

**What We Offer:**

* **Assured Payout / Stipend:** A steady payout during the initial 6\-month provisional phase, linked to the completion of basic target and activity benchmarks.
* **Performance\-Based Incentives:** High\-earning potential through lucrative commissions and incentives on top of the fixed payout components during the advisory phase.
* **Fast\-Track Promotion:** A transparent, guaranteed career path moving directly into a management role (Distribution Manager) upon milestone completion.
* **Corporate Training:** Comprehensive training on insurance products, sales techniques, and financial regulatory frameworks.

**Requirements \& Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Minimum Higher Secondary (10\+2 / HS) passed. Graduates or candidates with a BBA / Sales background are also welcome.
* **Experience:** Both driven freshers and experienced sales professionals (from banking, retail, or financial services backgrounds) are welcome to apply.
* **Skills:** Strong communication, interpersonal, and networking skills. Ability to work in a target\-driven environment.
* **Localization:** Good knowledge of the local market and a strong local network.

**Selection \& Onboarding Process:**

* Screening: Profile evaluation and personal interview rounds.
* Onboarding: Immediate joining as a Financial Advisor for the 6\-month Provisional Period.
* Confirmation: Complete minimal sales targets \-\> Transition to Distribution Manager.

Pay: ₹240,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kolkata, West Bengal: Reliably commute or willing to relocate with an employer\-provided relocation package (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: PROJECT MANAGER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
 



 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 


 ͏
 
 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
 



 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 Deliver
 



  
   

 1\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Client satisfaction
   

  
   

 PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
   

  
   

 2\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ operational efficiency
   

  
   

 Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
   

  
   

 3\.
   

  
   

 Delivery Management ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢Â‚Â¬Ã¢Â€Âœ Financials
   

  
   

 Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives
   

  
   

 5\.
   

  
   

 Capability Building
   

  
   

 % attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix
   

  
   

 6\.
   

  
   

 Team Management
   

  
   

 Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score
   

  
 


 ͏

 Experience: 8\-10 Years
   

 .

We are looking for a creative and passionate professional who can design attractive social media posters, create engaging videos, design logos and branding materials, and support digital marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate should have strong graphic design and video editing skills and be familiar with Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and modern AI\-powered creative tools.

What We Expect

* Creative thinking and attention to detail.
* Strong communication skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new AI and digital marketing tools.
* Positive attitude and team collaboration.

Bonus Skills

* Motion Graphics

title: DEVELOPER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




 The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
 


* Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
* Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
* Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
* Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
* Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
* Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
* Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities


 ͏
 
 2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
 


* Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
* Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
* Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
* Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
* Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
* Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
* Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
* Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
* Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders


 ͏
 
 3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
 


* Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
* Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
* Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
* Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
* Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
* Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
* Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
* Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally


 ͏

description:
Griffith Foods is the caring, creative product development partner helping food companies meet the evolving needs of consumers while sustaining the planet. As a family business founded in 1919 and headquartered in Alsip, Illinois USA, Griffith Foods is known for true, collaborative innovation guided by their Purpose of “We Blend Care and Creativity to Nourish the World”. The company’s product capabilities range from seasonings and marinades to coating systems and sauces that are better for people and better for the planet. For more information, visit www.griffithfoods.com.
   

  

**Industrial Relations \& Legal Compliance**
* Liaise with labor department, factory inspectorate, PF/ESI authorities, and other statutory bodies.
* Ensure adherence to applicable labor laws including the Factories Act, CLRA, EPF Act, Minimum Wages Act, etc.
* Conduct monthly labor management meetings and maintain all statutory records and registers.
* Prepare legal documentation, notices, responses, and support inspections or audits.
* Identify emerging IR risks and implement preventive measures during plant scale\-up or operational changes.


**Contractor Workforce Governance**
* Ensure full compliance of contract labor management as per CLRA and statutory norms.
* Monitor contractor adherence to PF, ESI, wages, working hours, and documentation standards.
* Drive recruitment, attendance control, and efficient deployment of contract workforce.
* Conduct audits of contractors/vendors to ensure governance and legal compliance.
* Manage manpower documentation for ongoing operations and expansion projects.


**Plant Statutory \& Safety Compliance**
* Oversee statutory requirements related to boiler, metrology, safety, environment, and PCB regulations.
* Ensure timely inspections, certifications, approvals, renewals, and statutory filings.
* Maintain all compliance statutory registers, licenses, renewals, and filings and documentation for audits, inspections, and regulatory visits and handle inspections, notices, and compliance audits.
* Coordinate welfare and safety activities in partnership with the plant safety team
* Welfare \& Safety: Oversee canteen, safety, and employee welfare activities in coordination with the safety team.
* Oversee statutory compliance for new plant expansion or equipment installation.


**Disciplinary \& Legal Matters**
* Draft and manage all legal documents, notices, and responses related to labor or statutory authorities.
* Handle grievances, misconduct cases, and disciplinary procedures legally.
* Conduct domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions with strict adherence to labor laws.
* Maintain documentation for legal defense in inspections or disputes.
* Completing initial reporting, accident investigations, communication work restrictions, claim adjuster correspondence, tracking and claim review analysis for settlement
* Draft charge sheets, warning letters, suspension and termination documentation.
* Represent the company in conciliation or labor proceedings if required.


**Risk Management \& Advisory**
* Advise management on statutory risks and gaps in compliance.
* Implement preventive measures to avoid legal violations or penalties.
* Keep management updated on changes in labor laws, environmental regulations, and plant statutory requirements.
* Ensure compliance during plant expansion, new shifts, or additional manpower deployment.
* Monitor overtime, working hours, wage structures, and safety compliance.
* Advise management on IR risks during rapid operational growth.


**HR Operations**
* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations at the plant, ensuring alignment with production priorities.
* Drive manpower planning and workforce budgeting in line with production forecasts.
* Oversee end\-to\-end recruitment and onboarding for plant workforce (permanent and contractual).
* Manage employee lifecycle processes including confirmation, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Drive performance management implementation for plant employees.
* Responsible for payroll inputs, attendance systems, shift management, and statutory deductions.
* Lead employee engagement initiatives and foster positive shop\-floor culture.
* Implement training and development programs focused on skill enhancement and compliance.
* Ensure effective employee communication, engagement, and grievance handling.
* Support succession planning and capability building for critical plant roles.
* Collaborate with production, maintenance, quality, and safety teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain plant HR dashboards (attrition, absenteeism, productivity, compliance status).

title: Technical Writing Lead
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a Technical Writing Lead to join the Engineering Services team. Reporting to the Information Management Team Lead, this role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru.
   

  

 The Technical Writing Lead is part of the Engineering Services team within Chevron’s ENGINE center. This role provides day\-to\-day leadership for a team of Technical Writers responsible for developing and maintaining critical operating documentation for oil and gas facilities. This team ensures procedures, work instructions, manuals, and related technical controls are accurate, current, and usable for the intended audience, while meeting applicable company standards, regulatory requirements, and Operational Excellence expectations. The Technical Writing Lead partners closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and HSE subject matter experts to translate complex technical information into clear, consistent documentation and to ensure changes from risk reviews and management\-of\-change activities are captured, reviewed, and implemented.
   

  

 Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Writers; set clear expectations for quality, timeliness, and stakeholder engagement.
* Plan, prioritize, and assign work across competing requests; manage workload, bottlenecks, and delivery commitments.
* Oversee development, revision, and maintenance of operating procedures, work instructions, operating manuals, process/equipment manuals, and other operational documentation (e.g., HSE and process safety content as applicable).
* Facilitate effective collaboration with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and HSE SMEs to gather inputs, validate technical accuracy, and confirm end\-user usability.
* Ensure documentation is fit\-for\-purpose for the intended audience (clarity, structure, readability, and correct level of detail), including application of Human and Organizational Performance (HOP) principles where required.
* Ensure changes from management\-of\-change activities and risk reviews (e.g., hazard reviews) are appropriately captured, assessed for documentation impact, and incorporated into affected documents.
* Establish and enforce documentation standards (templates, style guidance, controlled terminology), including consistent formatting, versioning, and approval workflows.
* Maintain document control discipline: revision history, traceability, approvals, distribution, and archival in the designated document management system.
* Monitor and report performance metrics (e.g., validation/periodic review timeliness, cycle time, backlog); identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve document quality.
* Provide training and guidance to Technical Writers and stakeholders on documentation expectations, workflows, and tool usage.
* Support audits and reviews by producing required documentation evidence and driving closure of documentation\-related findings/actions.


**About You**
 We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged.
   

  

**To Be Considered For This Role, Applicants Should Have**
* Degree in engineering, technical communication, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience in an industrial operating environment (including relevant trade/craft background).
* Demonstrated experience creating, editing, and maintaining technical procedures and controlled documentation used by operations, maintenance, and/or laboratory personnel.
* Proven capability to lead through influence and coordinate work across cross\-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.
* Strong command of written English, including the ability to draft, edit, and quality\-check complex technical content for accuracy and usability.
* Working knowledge of documentation lifecycle practices (authoring, review, approval, publishing, revision control, and periodic validation).
* Proficiency with common documentation tools such as Microsoft Word and collaboration/document control platforms (e.g., SharePoint or equivalent), and PDF editing software.
* 10\+ years of experience leading a technical writing team supporting a complex processing facility (e.g., LNG, refining, petrochemicals, offshore production, or similar).
* Experience developing or governing HSE and process safety documentation, including incorporation of outcomes from risk reviews and change management activities.
* Demonstrated experience applying Human and Organizational Performance (HOP) principles to procedure design and continuous improvement.
* Experience with digital/smart procedure platforms and workflow\-based request management tools.
* Strong facilitation skills (workshops, procedure walk\-throughs, and structured reviews with SMEs and end users).


**What We Can Offer You**
 Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
   

  

 Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
   

  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well\-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well\-being, and work\-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.


**How To Apply**
 To be a part of our success, click
 **APPLY** 
 to submit your application.
   

  

 Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time\-limited Visa status for this position.
   

  

**Privacy and Terms and Conditions**
 We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.
   

  

 Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.
   

  

 Terms of Use
   

  

 “ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.
   

  

 This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.

Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: AI Engineer: Agentic Systems & War Simulation
description:
***The goal is simple. Help India win the next war.***




 AlphaGo discovered moves in Go that no human had played in thousands of years of the game’s history. Moves that looked wrong to experts but proved devastatingly effective.
 



***We’re building the equivalent for air warfare.***




 A system where AI agents play through ten thousand conflict scenarios overnight, discover strategies that human planners would never consider, and stress\-test every plan against an adversary AI that actively tries to break it. India enters any conflict having already explored more of the strategic space than any human planning staff ever could. The war is fought in simulation a thousand times before it is fought once in reality, and the side that has done that preparation wins.
 



 This is not a simulation with better graphics. It is a tool that out\-thinks the adversary.
 



**What You’d Build** 




 You own the AI agent architecture. Someone else builds the simulation engine. You build the intelligence on top.
 


* Agents that reason about complex multi\-day, multi\-front operations and explore the strategy space at a scale no human planning staff can.
* Adversarial agents that find the weaknesses in any plan before the enemy does
* A learning loop where agents get meaningfully smarter over thousands of self\-play iterations.
* A reasoning layer that can explain to a military commander why a strategy works and where it breaks, with specific evidence



**The hard problems you’d spend your time on:** 



1. How do you represent the state of a complex, partially observable conflict so an agent can reason about it effectively?
2. How do you combine long\-horizon strategic planning with tactical adaptation?
3. How do you build a Red agent that is genuinely dangerous rather than a scripted opponent?
4. How do you make agent reasoning auditable and trustworthy enough that a commander acts on it?



**Why This Is Hard** 




 The action space is enormous. The environment is partially observable and stochastic. The adversary adapts. Planning horizons span days, not moves. A single decision (when to commit reserves, which front to prioritize) cascades in ways that only become visible much later.
 



 Standard approaches break in ways that are obvious once you understand the problem, but non\-obvious if you’re pattern\-matching from existing work. No standard playbook exists for this. You’d be designing the architecture from first principles.
 



**Who This Is For** 




 We don’t care about years of experience or seniority. We care about how you think.
 



 The bar is: can you design and build an agentic architecture that outcompetes systems built by teams ten times your size at companies with a hundred times your budget? If yes, the rest doesn’t matter.
 



**What we’re looking for:** 



* Exceptional first\-principles thinking. You derive architectures from the problem, not from what you’ve seen others do.
* Deep independence. You take an ambiguous, open\-ended problem and come back with a working system. No hand\-holding, no waiting for specs.
* Technical brilliance in at least one of: reinforcement learning, LLM agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, game AI. You don’t need to be broad. You need to be devastatingly good at the thing you’re good at.
* No defence background required. No specific tool or framework required.



***"If the idea of building an AlphaGo for warfare doesn’t make you want to drop everything, this isn’t for you. If it does, we’d like to talk."***

description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title**

EHS Officer

**Department**

EHS

**Location**

Mumbai

**Reporting To**

Manager \- EHS

**Job Summary**

The EHS Officer is responsible for implementing, monitoring, and enforcing Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) standards across commercial interior fit\-out project sites. The role ensures compliance with company policies, client requirements, and statutory regulations while promoting a proactive safety culture. The incumbent will lead site safety inspections, risk assessments, permit\-to\-work management, incident investigations, safety training programs, and emergency preparedness initiatives to ensure safe project execution and achievement of organizational EHS objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**EHS Management \& Compliance**

* Implement and monitor EHS policies, procedures, and safety management systems across project sites.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory regulations, client requirements, and company safety standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and compliance assessments.
* Monitor subcontractor safety performance and ensure adherence to project EHS requirements.
* Ensure all work activities are executed in accordance with approved safety procedures and risk control measures.

**Hazard Identification \& Risk Management**

* Conduct Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA) for project activities.
* Review Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements, and Risk Assessments.
* Identify safety hazards and implement preventive and corrective actions.
* Monitor high\-risk activities including work at height, hot work, lifting operations, electrical work, and confined space activities.

**Permit\-to\-Work (PTW) Management**

* Administer and monitor Permit\-to\-Work systems for critical activities.
* Ensure permits are properly authorized, implemented, and closed.
* Verify compliance with permit requirements before work commencement.

**Incident Management**

* Investigate accidents, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Conduct root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain incident records and ensure timely reporting to management and clients.
* Track closure of corrective actions arising from investigations.

**Training \& Safety Awareness**

* Conduct EHS induction programs for employees, workers, subcontractors, and visitors.
* Deliver toolbox talks, safety campaigns, and awareness programs.
* Promote behavioral safety initiatives and continuous safety improvement.
* Develop safety communication materials and awareness content.

**Emergency Preparedness \& Response**

* Develop and implement emergency response plans for project sites.
* Organize emergency drills, mock exercises, and evacuation programs.
* Ensure availability and maintenance of emergency equipment, first\-aid facilities, and firefighting systems.
* Coordinate emergency response activities during incidents.

**Documentation \& Reporting**

* Maintain EHS records, registers, permits, audit reports, and compliance documentation.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly EHS performance reports.
* Monitor and report safety KPIs, observations, incidents, and compliance metrics.
* Support client audits, external inspections, and certification requirements.

**Environmental Management**

* Monitor environmental compliance related to waste management, dust control, noise management, and housekeeping.
* Promote environmentally sustainable practices across project sites.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and project requirements.

**Leadership \& Coordination**

* Guide and supervise Assistant EHS Officers, EHS Supervisors, and EHS Stewards.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, and subcontractors on EHS matters.
* Support achievement of project safety objectives and organizational EHS goals.
* Any other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Science, Environmental Management, or any related discipline.
* Diploma/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, Occupational Health \& Safety, Fire \& Safety, or equivalent.

**Experience**

* 4–7 years of relevant experience in EHS within Commercial Interior Fit\-Out, Construction, Infrastructure, Industrial, or Manufacturing projects.
* Strong experience in site safety management and statutory compliance.
* Experience managing subcontractor safety and permit\-to\-work systems.
* Knowledge of client EHS requirements and safety audits.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* NEBOSH IGC.
* IOSH Managing Safely.
* OSHA Certification.
* First Aid \& CPR Certification.
* ISO 45001 Internal Auditor Certification.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Competencies**

**Technical Skills**

* Construction Safety Management.
* Hazard Identification \& Risk Assessment (HIRA).
* Permit\-to\-Work (PTW) Management.
* Incident Investigation \& Root Cause Analysis.
* Emergency Response Planning.
* Safety Audits \& Compliance Monitoring.
* Environmental Management.
* EHS Reporting \& Documentation.
* Knowledge of OSHA, NEBOSH, ISO 45001, and applicable statutory regulations.
* Strong understanding of commercial interior fit\-out construction activities.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Leadership and Supervision.
* Communication and Presentation Skills.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Problem Solving and Decision Making.
* Attention to Detail.
* Conflict Resolution.
* Team Collaboration.
* Accountability and Integrity.
* Adaptability and Results Orientation.

**Internal Stakeholders**

* EHS Manager
* Project Managers
* Site Engineers
* Construction Supervisors
* HR Department
* Operations Team
* Procurement Team
* Project Workforce

**External Stakeholders**

* Clients and Client Safety Representatives
* Consultants
* Subcontractors
* Government Safety Authorities
* Emergency Service Providers
* Certification and Audit Agencies

**Recruitment Manager – Leadership \& Commercial Portfolios**

**Company:** S3V Vascular Technologies

**Location:** Oragadam

**Department:** Human Resources

**Reports To:** Head of HR / Director

**About S3V Vascular Technologies**

S3V Vascular Technologies is a pioneering MedTech organization dedicated to innovating cutting\-edge medical technologies that are both advanced and affordable. Founded by a team of visionary technologists, S3V specializes in developing minimally invasive solutions that reduce surgical risks and improve patient recovery. Globally recognized for excellence in the cardiovascular and neurovascular segments, we are rapidly expanding our manufacturing and commercial footprint across India and international markets. Our mission is simple: to create a better world by saving lives through innovation.

**The Role**

We are seeking a high\-caliber, strategic **Recruitment Manager** to lead our Talent Acquisition engine across India. In this critical role, you will take complete ownership of building our corporate leadership, high\-performance sales, and strategic marketing teams. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business strategy and talent pipelines, sourcing top\-tier professionals who understand cath labs, medical device commercialization, and corporate governance. This role requires a blend of executive search sophistication, data\-driven recruitment mapping, and aggressive headhunting capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Talent Mapping \& Sourcing**

* **Pan\-India Commercial Sourcing:** Build a robust, proactive pipeline for the Sales \& Marketing division, tracking top performers from competitor medical device, pharma, and healthcare companies across key Indian clusters.
* **Executive \& Leadership Hiring:** Lead the end\-to\-end executive search process for senior management, C\-suite, and specialized technical leadership roles, maintaining a high\-touch, premium candidate experience.
* **Agile Headhunting:** Move beyond standard job boards; actively leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, clinical/industry networks, and professional forums to map out passive talent.

**Business Partnership \& Stakeholder Management**

* **Advisory Role:** Partner closely with Founders, Business Heads, and the Sales Leadership team to understand regional market dynamics and headcount requirements.
* **JD Calibration:** Conduct thorough intake meetings to define core competencies, align expectations, and create compelling mandates for complex positions.

**Operational Excellence \& Metrics**

* **Cycle\-Time Optimization:** Own and optimize recruitment metrics, including Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Quality of Hire, and Source Mix.
* **Vendor \& Budget Management:** Evaluate, onboard, and manage specialized executive search firms and consultants, ensuring strict adherence to delivery timelines and cost\-efficiencies.
* **ATS \& Data Integrity:** Maintain immaculate data hygiene within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to provide regular, real\-time analytics to the executive leadership team.

**Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience**

* **Positioning S3V:** Position S3V as an employer of choice within the Indian MedTech ecosystem, communicating our vision, scale\-up trajectory, and impact on patient care.
* **Process Excellence:** Ensure a seamless, transparent, and respectful onboarding journey for all candidates, from the first contact through offer negotiation and integration.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Experience:** 10–15 years of intensive corporate recruitment or executive search experience. **A minimum of 5–8 years strictly within the Medical Device, MedTech, or Pharmaceutical industries is mandatory.**
* **Domain Expertise:** Proven track record of successfully closing high\-value commercial roles (Area/National Sales Managers, Product Managers, Marketing Heads) and leadership roles (Directors, Function Heads).
* **Network:** An established, active network of professionals within the Indian healthcare commercial ecosystem.
* **Education:** **An MBA or Post Graduate Degree in Human Resources is strongly preferred.**
* **Negotiation \& Acumen:** Exceptional negotiation skills with a deep understanding of corporate compensation structuring,
* **Soft Skills:** High business acumen, exceptional articulation, resilience, and a high\-ownership mindset capable of managing ambiguous, fast\-paced scale\-up environments.

**Why Join S3V?**

At S3V, you won't just fill open requisitions—you will actively architect the teams that build and commercialize life\-saving technologies. We offer a high\-visibility environment where your strategic talent decisions directly fuel our national expansion and shape the corporate culture of a rising global MedTech leader.

**Apply Now:** Send your updated profile and a brief summary of your most challenging leadership closures to **amrut\_katekar@s3vvascular.com** with the subject line *"Application: Recruitment Manager"*.

**Role**

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery


**͏**
-----

**Do**

* Delivery Management
* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement
* Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs

  

* Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
* Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
* Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
* Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
* Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
* Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks

* Operational Excellence
* Automation Focus

* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing

* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account

title: Jr. SEO Analyst
description:
**Job Title: SEO Analyst – Fresher** **Key Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Perform daily **backlink building activities** to meet assigned targets.
* Research and identify **high\-quality domains/websites** for link\-building opportunities to improve website traffic and authority.

* Completed an **SEO internship or basic training in SEO**.
* Basic understanding of **on\-page and off\-page SEO concepts**.
* Familiarity with SEO tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Search Console, keyword research tools).
* Basic knowledge of **meta tags, keyword placement, and content optimization**.
* Strong **writing skills** for creating SEO\-friendly content
* Good analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and meet daily targets.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**About Us**

We are Vellaration Technologies Private Limited, an innovative automation company helping businesses eliminate manual bottlenecks and scale their revenue. As we grow our tech and sales operations, we are looking for an organized, articulate, and confident HR Intern to manage our end\-to\-end talent acquisition, candidate screening, and employee relations.

**Job Description**

Are you an MBA or BBA student specializing in HR who wants real\-world experience running a company’s people operations? Do you possess excellent communication skills and the confidence to handle professional compliance and candidate screening?

We are seeking an HR Generalist Intern who will act as the backbone of our recruitment and team management. In this role, you will not just source resumes—you will manage our entire hiring pipeline on Indeed, conduct initial screening interviews, draft legal contracts, and ensure our active team maintains the highest standards of professional conduct.

**Key Responsibilities**

**End\-to\-End Recruitment:** Post job descriptions on Indeed/LinkedIn, filter applications, and aggressively screen out candidates who lack the right technical skills or professional attitude.

**Interview Scheduling \& Logistics:** Coordinate and schedule Google Meet interviews, ensuring correct timezone mapping and calendar syncs to eliminate technical overlap glitches.

**Onboarding \& Documentation:** Draft official Offer Letters and Internship Agreements for selected candidates, and follow up closely to ensure signed copies are returned before deadlines.

**Performance \& Compliance Tracking:** Keep a close eye on intern attendance, responsiveness, and deadlines.

**Workplace Discipline:** Serve as the point of contact for team accountability. Draft and issue formal warning emails or termination notices if an intern exhibits unprofessional behavior or misses core company meetings.

**Qualifications \& Required Skills**

**Education:** Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA or BBA in Human Resources (HR).

**Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. You must be able to write clear, firm, and professional corporate emails.

**Tech\-Savvy:** Comfortable working with Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Sheets) and managing online job portals.

**Personality:** High emotional intelligence combined with a firm, professional boundary\-setting mindset. You must be comfortable addressing unprofessional behavior or enforcing company rules directly.

**What You Will Gain**

**True Autonomy:** Gain real, non\-administrative HR experience managing a live company workflow from Day 1\.

**Strategic Leadership:** Learn how a fast\-growing tech startup builds and filters its team structure.

**Documentation:** Official Internship Certificate and an executive Letter of Recommendation upon successful completion of your tenure.

**Future Employment:** Outstanding performers will be prioritized for full\-time HR Generalist positions at the company.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 per month

**Industry:** Education / Social Impact / Legal Compliance \& Child Safeguarding

About Right Side Story

Right Side Story is India’s trusted child safeguarding organization. We partner with over 1,500 educational institutions, schools, and colleges across Asia to implement robust child protection policies, conduct POCSO and POSH audits, and build legally defensible safeguarding frameworks. Through our student well\-being workshops, we empower educators, parents, and students with critical conversations around menstrual health, consent, identity, and personal safety.

By shifting the conversation from simple intent to rigorous, legally compliant practice, we are transforming school safety architecture nationally. We operate in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment where structural discipline meets deep social impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, highly organized **HR and Talent Acquisition Specialist** on a **6\-month contractual basis** to spearhead our end\-to\-end recruitment process.

In this role, your sole mandate will be managing the talent pipeline. You will act as the crucial link between internal department heads and potential talent, driving the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding stages. If you are a recruiter who excels at finding the right talent, managing fast\-paced hiring cycles, and facilitating smooth candidate transitions, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities1\. Sourcing \& Screening (Hiring)

· **Talent Requirement Gathering:** Coordinate closely with functional heads across departments (Sales, Operations, Programs) to understand active hiring needs and skill requirements.

· **JD Creation:** Design and draft clear, compelling, and accurate Job Descriptions based on the functional requirements of each team.

· **Portal Management:** Actively utilize job boards and recruitment channels (including Naukri.com, Indeed, and LinkedIn) to source high\-quality resumes.

· **First\-Level Screening:** Review resumes, conduct first\-round screening calls to assess communication, alignment, and basic qualifications, and filter out mismatched candidates.

· **Interview Scheduling:** Coordinate calendar availability with department heads and schedule subsequent technical or functional interview rounds for shortlisted candidates.

2\. Recruitment \& Onboarding

· **Compensation Negotiation:** Initiate and manage package negotiations with selected candidates, aligning expectations with internal company budgets.

· **Offer Letters:** Draft and dispatch formal offer letters and employment contracts to selected hires with accurate terms and clauses.

· **Onboarding Support:** Facilitate a structured onboarding experience for new joiners (interns, full\-time staff, and contract\-based trainers), ensuring all necessary pre\-joining documentation is collected.

Qualifications \& Requirements

· **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

· **Experience:**

o 1 \- 2 years of dedicated experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.

o **Freshers with relevant skills** (e.g., exceptional communication skills, highly organized mindset, prior recruitment internships, or strong coordination skills) are also highly encouraged to apply.

o Experience recruiting for field\-heavy startups, EdTech, or NGOs is a major plus.

· **Hiring Expertise:** Familiarity with or hands\-on experience working with hiring portals like Naukri, Indeed, and LinkedIn to fill both corporate roles and high\-volume operations profiles.

· **Contract Commitment:** Ability to commit fully to a **6\-month, on\-site contract** in Noida.

· **Skills:**

o Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to close offers efficiently.

o Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for candidate interaction and JD writing.

o Highly organized, with strong scheduling habits and database discipline.

**About us**

At **V7 AI Solutions LLP**, we are passionate about building AI that understands, learns, and acts on real\-world problems responsibly. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of artificial intelligence—intelligent, adaptive, autonomous, and ethical—while creating solutions that transform industries, empower organizations, and improve human lives.

At V7 AI, you’ll be part of a **dynamic, fast\-growing environment** where curiosity, creativity, and collaboration are highly valued. Working five days a week from our Bengaluru office (9:30 AM – 7:00 PM) allows our team to learn from each other, brainstorm ideas in real\-time, and build products faster and smarter.

**About the Role**

As an HR Intern at V7 AI Solutions, you will work closely with the teams to support recruitment operations, candidate coordination, onboarding activities and improving internal HR policies, employee processes, operational systems across the company.

You will also work closely with engineering team leads and hiring stakeholders to understand role requirements and support end\-to\-end hiring coordination, from candidate sourcing and screening to interview management, communication, and onboarding support.

This internship is designed for individuals who want hands\-on exposure to modern startup hiring, people operations, employer branding, and organizational coordination. You will contribute to real hiring workflows while learning how fast\-growing teams build scalable and structured people processes.

This role is highly execution\-oriented and requires strong ownership, communication and willingness to learn.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication, coordination, and organisational skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to handle multiple tasks responsibly.
* Logical thinking, problem\-solving mindset, and willingness to learn.
* Comfortable with Google Workspace, MS Office, spreadsheets, and collaboration platforms.
* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, Management, or related field (preferred but not mandatory for highly driven candidates).
* Prior internship, coordination, or event management experience is a plus.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, hiring platforms, or workflow tools is an advantage.

**Responsibilities**

Recruitment Coordination

* Assist in posting job openings across platforms such as LinkedIn, job portals, and internal channels.
* Help screen candidate applications based on defined criteria and role requirements.
* Coordinate interview schedules, assessments, and candidate communications.
* Maintain hiring trackers, candidate databases, and interview records.
* Work closely with engineering leads and hiring stakeholders to coordinate hiring activities and hiring pipeline updates.

Candidate Communication

* Send emails and follow\-ups for interviews, assessments, onboarding, and documentation.
* Act as a professional and responsive point of contact for candidates during the hiring process.
* Ensure candidates receive timely updates and clear communication throughout their journey.

HR Operations \& Onboarding

* Assist in onboarding activities including documentation collection, employee data entry, and induction coordination.
* Support HR administrative processes and maintain organized records.
* Coordinate with internal teams for onboarding readiness and operational requirements.

Process Improvement \& Automation

* Help identify repetitive manual tasks and support process optimization initiatives.
* Assist in improving trackers, templates, workflows, and reporting systems.
* Explore simple automation opportunities using spreadsheets, forms, AI tools, or workflow platforms.

**Who Thrives Here**

* Takes full ownership of follow\-ups, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder coordination without needing step\-by\-step direction.
* Thinks in systems — able to spot inefficiencies and improve processes through optimisation or automation.
* Handles high\-volume coordination work without losing accuracy or attention to detail.
* Communicates confidently with candidates, founders, hiring managers, and engineering leads.
* Comfortable with fast\-paced environments where priorities shift and timelines are tight.
* High learning agility — quickly understands business, hiring, and operational contexts.
* Disciplined in maintaining records, trackers, reports, and operational consistency.
* Curious about AI tools, automation, and operational efficiency improvements.
* We value execution quality, ownership, and structured thinking — more than credentials alone.
* Candidates who rely on templates without understanding context may struggle in this role.

**This Role May Not Be a Good Fit If**

* You prefer repetitive work with fixed instructions for every task.
* You struggle with follow\-ups, coordination, or maintaining operational discipline.
* You are uncomfortable with fast\-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* You dislike structured documentation, tracking systems, or process\-oriented work.
* You prefer low\-ownership environments with limited accountability.

**Internship Structure**

* **The duration of the internship is 3 months.**
* Interns who demonstrate strong performance, design ownership, learning ability, and meaningful contribution may be considered for internship extension

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work closely with the Directors, Operations, and Engineering teams at V7 AI Solutions — gaining exposure to cross\-functional collaboration and real\-world startup operations.

**What You Will Learn**

During this internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* Recruitment operations
* Candidate lifecycle management
* Employer branding
* HR operations and onboarding
* Hiring coordination and stakeholder management
* Process management and workflow optimisation
* Startup execution and organisational systems

**What Success Looks Like**

* Hiring coordination runs smoothly and efficiently.
* Candidates receive timely and professional communication.
* Recruitment and onboarding records remain accurate and organised.
* Internal teams receive reliable operational support.
* HR workflows become more structured, scalable, and efficient over time.

**Why Join Us**

At V7 AI Solutions, you will work in a fast\-moving environment where your contribution directly impacts hiring quality and operational efficiency.

This internship is ideal for individuals who enjoy solving operational problems, coordinating execution, improving systems, and contributing meaningfully in a high\-ownership startup environment.

description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

**Job Title: TSI \- OEM \& Panel Builders**


As a TSI at **Polycab**, you will be the face of our industrial electrical solutions. You’ll focus on growing our footprint with **OEM** \& **Panel Builders**. description:
**\*\* HR Executive \*\***
==========================


Remote (India) \| Full‑Time \| UK Time Zone Support\*\*

**Role Overview**
-----------------


The **HR Executive** will manage recruitment operations, onboarding, background verification, and contract workforce administration for India‑based consultants deployed to **UK clients**. This is a **full‑time remote role aligned to UK working hours**, requiring strong communication, process ownership, and the ability to manage multiple HR workflows independently.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Recruitment Talent Acquisition**

* Manage **end‑to‑end hiring**for IT and non‑IT roles across India.
* Source candidates via **LinkedIn, Indeed, internal databases, referrals**.
* Conduct **HR screening** to assess communication, experience, and suitability.
* Coordinate interviews with UK hiring managers and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain **candidate pipelines, trackers, and weekly hiring dashboards**.
* Support offer negotiation, issuance, and acceptance management.

### **2\. Onboarding Compliance**

* Coordinate **pre‑joining formalities**, document collection, and verification.
* Prepare **offer letters, contracts, NDAs, SOWs, extensions**, and onboarding kits.
* Ensure smooth onboarding for consultants deployed to UK client projects.
* Maintain accurate **employee files, HRIS entries, and compliance documentation**.

### **3\. Background Verification (BGV)**

* Initiate and manage **BGV checks**(employment, education, address, ID).
* Liaise with BGV vendors and ensure timely completion of verification reports.
* Track BGV status and escalate delays to internal teams or clients.
* Ensure compliance with **UK client standards and audit requirements**.

### **4\. Timesheet Attendance Management**

* Collect, validate, and consolidate **weekly/monthly timesheets**from consultants.
* Follow up with consultants and client managers for missing or incorrect entries.
* Maintain accurate **attendance, billable hours, and utilization records**.
* Prepare timesheet summaries for payroll and invoicing teams.

### **5\. Invoicing Contract Workforce Administration**

* Coordinate with finance to support **invoice preparation**based on approved timesheets.
* Validate billing rates, hours, and contract terms before invoicing.
* Track invoice submissions, approvals, and payment status.
* Maintain **invoice logs, contract billing cycles, and renewal schedules**.
* Support contract workforce lifecycle: onboarding extensions exits.

### **6\. Client Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the **primary HR point of contact** for UK clients and internal delivery teams.
* Provide timely updates on hiring, onboarding, BGV, and consultant status.
* Participate in UK‑time client calls, requirement discussions, and weekly reviews.
* Ensure SLA adherence, professionalism, and high‑quality communication.

**Required Skills Experience**
------------------------------

* **2–5 years**of experience in HR, recruitment, or HR operations.
* Strong experience in **contract staffing, onboarding, BGV, timesheet invoicing workflows**.
* Prior experience supporting **UK or international clients**is highly preferred.
* Excellent **English communication**and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel, Google Sheets, HRMS/ATS tools**.
* Strong attention to detail, process orientation, and ability to work independently.
* Comfortable working **full‑time in UK time zone (BST/GMT)**.

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field**.
* HR certifications are an added advantage.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

**Location:** Remote (India\-based; Preferred: Coimbatore, Chandigarh, Pune, or Hyderabad)

**Industry Focus:** Real Estate, Logistics, \& Hospitality

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented, multi\-disciplinary **Operations \& Finance Administrator** to serve as the backbone of our remote back\-office. This is not a standard data\-entry role; you will be responsible for the "engine room" of our business—managing the flow of money (AP/Payroll), the accuracy of our records (Audit/Booking), and the integration of new team members (Onboarding).

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment and understands the specific operational pressures of the property, transport, and service industries.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Finance \& Bookkeeping (The "Numbers" Pillar)**

* **Accounts Payable (AP):** Manage vendor relationships, verify invoices against delivery logs (Logistics), and process payments for property maintenance (Real Estate).
* **Audit \& Reconciliation:** Conduct weekly audits of bank statements and internal ledgers to ensure 100% accuracy in Hospitality booking revenues.
* **Payroll:** Execute end\-to\-end payroll processing, including tax compliance and expense reimbursements.

**2\. HR \& People Operations (The "Growth" Pillar)**

* **Seamless Onboarding:** Manage the digital onboarding lifecycle for new hires—from contract generation to tool access and orientation.
* **Compliance:** Maintain digital employee files and ensure all remote work policies are signed and filed.

**3\. Industry\-Specific Administration (The "Support" Pillar)**

* **Real Estate:** Track lease renewals and manage utility billing across property portfolios.
* **Logistics:** Monitor Vendor documentation for Repairs and Maintenance and coordinate with field teams for billing accuracy.
* **Hospitality:** Vendor Management, Implementation of Critical timelines for IT and other new product roll\-out initiatives

**4\. Data Analysis \& Reporting**

* Create weekly "Health Reports" on cash flow, occupancy rates (Real Estate), and fleet efficiency (Logistics).

* **Experience:** 3–5\+ years in a back\-office, HR, or accounting role. Experience in Real Estate or Logistics is a significant plus.
* **Tech Stack:** Proficiency in QuickBooks/Xero, HRIS systems, and advanced Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal English—able to coordinate across different time zones and cultures.
* **Mindset:** A "detective" mindset for auditing and a "concierge" mindset for onboarding

* You can manage a large number of requisitions at once with varying levels of complexity

* You have demonstrated experience being adaptable in changing and evolving situations and work environments; you act quickly, even if it means going outside of your comfort zone because you love to learn
* You demonstrate optimism every day and show a strong desire to succeed and thrive while keeping a positive attitude and bringing your team members along with you
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and are excited by chances to define and build something from nothing

**Duties:**

* Scheduling Training and coordinating schedules with Trainers
* Creating work schedules once the Employee is ready to begin work

**HR \- Payroll**

* On\-line insurance/401(k) employee enrollment, updates \& terminations
* Monthly insurance premium auditing \& processing
* Maintain payroll tax database and coordinate tax notices with 3rd party
* Maintain/update employee personnel files and data bases

* Prepare reports for Accounting and Human Resources as directed
* Ensure payroll and employee information is accurately recorded
* Maintain confidentiality of payroll and employee information

**Accounting**

* Bank Reconciliation – reconcile bank statements and credit card statements monthly
